pair_protocol: Sequential. Each attempt: new run ID, fresh snapshot, regenerated v2 plan (SHA must match), copy of this package without runtime Saved, wait for 30 s with no UnrealEditor/UnrealEditor-Cmd process, Baseline then ComplexAsSimple via run_complex_candidate.ps1 (which refuses to launch if an editor is running), validator, source immutability. Other-editor presence during a pair is sampled every 500 ms and flagged.
stopping_rule: Stop immediately after the first attempt in which either process ends with a FAIL_* status (candidate stall is the target; a baseline stall also stops the batch). Otherwise stop after 12 pair attempts. Harness aborts (a mode refused or not launched) count as attempts but not as complete pairs. No further batch is launched automatically.
no_stall_outcome: STALL_NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_BOUNDED_BATCH, reported with the number of complete pairs; previous failures are not declared resolved and no overall correctness PASS is issued.
